capabilities: Maps notes to HedgeDoc documents through a configurable frontmatter link
Pushes and pulls notes by hand or automatically on save
Live-syncs edits, cursors, and presence between Obsidian and HedgeDoc
Creates HedgeDoc documents from notes and notes from HedgeDoc documents
Browses server history and imports missing HedgeDoc notes into the vault
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13+); HedgeDoc 2 and Socket.IO 2 servers unsupported; session cookies kept in Obsidian secret storage; no telemetry, ads, or paid features.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or edit HedgeDoc documents, so keeping a note and its HedgeDoc twin identical means manual copy-paste.

relations.evidence: Sync Obsidian notes with HedgeDoc documents using frontmatter links and hedgesync.

summary: Two-way sync plugin that maps Obsidian notes to HedgeDoc documents via frontmatter links, with manual push/pull, auto-push, and real-time live sync.
